# dna — DomainNameAPI CLI

> dna is the command line client and MCP server for the DomainNameAPI reseller REST API
> (https://api.domainresellerapi.com, test environment https://ote.domainresellerapi.com). It searches, registers,
> renews and transfers domains and manages DNS records, DNSSEC, contacts, SSL certificates and hosting. Output is JSON
> when piped, errors are JSON with stable exit codes, and billable or destructive commands require explicit
> confirmation (--yes, or confirm=true over MCP).

Run `dna agent guide` for a version-matched usage guide and `dna schema <operation>` for the JSON Schema of any input.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/domainreseller/cli/blob/main/README.md): install, quick start, safety model
- [Getting started](https://github.com/domainreseller/cli/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md): OTE login, first registration and DNS change
- [Configuration](https://github.com/domainreseller/cli/blob/main/docs/configuration.md): credentials, environments, profiles, environment variables
- [Usage](https://github.com/domainreseller/cli/blob/main/docs/usage.md): inputs, --body, output formats, --jq, pagination, rate limits
- [AI agents and MCP](https://github.com/domainreseller/cli/blob/main/docs/ai-agents.md): MCP setup per client, confirmation protocol, skill
- [Errors and exit codes](https://github.com/domainreseller/cli/blob/main/docs/errors.md)
